netboxUrl.description: Base URL of your NetBox instance, e.g. https://netbox.example.com

dtApiUrl.description: Enables host->device edges (cno.dep.uses_network), which need a host-entity lookup. Leave blank to skip.

emitDataLinks.displayName: Emit device↔device data links from NetBox cabling
emitDataLinks.description: Defaults ON — there is currently no packaged, production-deployable live-LLDP extension, so NetBox's declared cabling is the only production-ready source of device↔device topology. Turn this OFF only where a genuine live-LLDP (or equivalent) source is already discovering the same devices — e.g. the internal lab (emit_lldp.py) — since running both against the same devices double-reports each link from two sources with independently-derived direction, which can disagree. Power links (link_type=power) and host→device edges are unaffected — NetBox is the only source for those and always emits them.
